'''Jonathan D. Teubner''' is an American researcher and writer. He is a research associate at [[Harvard University School of Mining and Practical Geology|Harvard University's]] [[Flourishing|Human Flourishing]] Program. Teubner is known for his work in the [[history of philosophy]], [[theology]], and [[cultural sociology]].

==Early life and education==
Teubner grew up in [[Stillwater, Oklahoma]]. Teubner earned a BS in economics from [[Oklahoma State University]] in 2006.<ref>{{Cite web |title=Jonathan Teubner |url=https://aiandfaith.org/member/jonathan-teubner/ |access-date=2026-03-03 |website=AI and Faith |language=en-US}}</ref> He later completed an MA in philosophy of religion at [[Yale University]] in 2010.<ref>{{Cite web |last=Life |first=Faith and Public |date=2014-01-29 |title=Jonathan Teubner |url=https://faithandpubliclife.com/jonathan-teubner/ |access-date=2026-03-03 |website=Faith and Public Life |language=en-US}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |date=2025-03-27 |title=Video: Humanity Meets AI: AI and Society {{!}} Religion and Public Life |url=https://rpl.hds.harvard.edu/news/2025/03/27/video-humanity-meets-ai-ai-and-society |access-date=2026-03-03 |website=rpl.hds.harvard.edu |language=en}}</ref> Teubner studied Arabic and religious studies at the [[University of Tubingen]] from 2007 to 2008. He completed a PhD in intellectual history at the [[University of Cambridge]] in 2013.<ref>https://shape.nato.int/upcoming-events/nato-communicators-conference-2024/speakers/jonathan-d-teubner</ref><ref>{{Cite web |last=Jay |first=John |date=2015-05-30 |title=Jonathon Teubner '05 |url=https://www.johnjayfellows.com/fellow-stories/2015/5/30/jonathon-teubner-05 |access-date=2026-03-03 |website=John Jay Institute |language=en-US}}</ref>

== Career ==
After completing his doctorate, he held a [[Fernand Braudel]] postdoctoral fellowship at [[Universite Paris-Sorbonne|Paris-Sorbonne University]] from 2014 to 2015.<ref>{{Cite web |date=2024-09-16 |title=Jonathan Teubner - Oklahoma State University |url=https://cas.okstate.edu/alumni/distinguished_alumni/teubner_jonathan.html |access-date=2026-03-03 |website=cas.okstate.edu |language=en}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |last=Affairs |first=Berkley Center for Religion, Peace and World |title=President as Theologian-in-Chief, for Better or Worse? |url=https://berkleycenter.georgetown.edu/responses/president-as-theologian-in-chief-for-better-or-worse |access-date=2026-03-03 |website=berkleycenter.georgetown.edu |language=en}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |title=Jonathan D. Teubner |url=https://themarginaliareview.com/about/contributors/jonathan-d-teubner/ |access-date=2026-03-03 |website=The Marginalia Review of Books |language=en-US}}</ref> He later worked at the [[University of Virginia]] from 2015 to 2019 as associate director of the university's research program on Religion, Politics and Conflict.<ref>{{Cite web |title=Jonathan Teubner |url=http://iasculture.org/events/jonathan-teubner |access-date=2026-03-03 |website=Institute for Advanced Studies in Culture |language=en}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |title=Jonathan Teubner |url=https://berkleycenter.georgetown.edu/people/jonathan-teubner |access-date=2026-03-03 |website=berkleycenter.georgetown.edu |language=en}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |title=Jonathan Teubner {{!}} Syndicate |url=https://syndicate.network/author/jonathan-teubner/ |access-date=2026-03-03 |language=en-US}}</ref> From 2019 to 2022, Teubner was a Research Fellow at [[Humboldt University of Berlin]].<ref>{{Cite web |title=Jonathan D Teubner {{!}} The Institute for Quantitative Social Science |url=https://www.iq.harvard.edu/people/jonathan-d-teubner |access-date=2026-03-03 |website=www.iq.harvard.edu |language=en}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |title=AI and Flourishing {{!}} The Human Flourishing Program |url=https://hfh.fas.harvard.edu/ai-and-flourishing |access-date=2026-03-03 |website=hfh.fas.harvard.edu |language=en}}</ref>

In 2021, he joined [[Harvard University]] as a research associate and program lead with the [[Flourishing|Human Flourishing]] Program.<ref name=":0">{{Cite web |title=Jonathan Teubner {{!}} The Human Flourishing Program |url=https://hfh.fas.harvard.edu/people/jonathan-teubner |access-date=2026-03-03 |website=hfh.fas.harvard.edu |language=en}}</ref> In the same year he co-founded of FilterLabs.AI, a [[data analytics]] company that analyzes public sentiment using online and social media content.<ref>https://www.nytimes.com/2026/01/08/us/politics/russia-propaganda-venezuela.html</ref><ref>{{Cite news |last=Barnes |first=Julian E. |date=2024-08-22 |title=Russian Attitudes About Putin Might Be Shifting |url=https://www.nytimes.com/2024/08/22/us/politics/russia-putin-attitudes-social-media.html |access-date=2026-03-03 |work=The New York Times |language=en-US |issn=0362-4331}}</ref><ref>{{Cite news |last=Barnes |first=Julian E. |date=2023-05-26 |title=Russian Public Appears to Be Souring on War Casualties, Analysis Shows |url=https://www.nytimes.com/2023/05/26/us/politics/russia-public-opinion-ukraine-war.html |access-date=2026-03-03 |work=The New York Times |language=en-US |issn=0362-4331}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |title=Jan. 31: Winter weather, Minnesota |url=https://www.nbcnews.com/nightly-news-netcast/video/nbc-nightly-news-full-episode-jan-31-256962117660 |access-date=2026-03-03 |website=NBC News |language=en}}</ref>

Teubner's research has focused on [[history of philosophy]], [[theology]], and [[cultural sociology]]. His work also includes research on the relationship between artificial intelligence and human flourishing. He has published books on [[St. Augustine of Hippo]] and the development of the [[Latin theology|Latin theological]] tradition, including ''Prayer after Augustine: A Study in the Development of the Latin Tradition'' (2018), which won the [[Manfred Lautenschlaeger Award]] for Theological Promise in 2019, and ''Charity after Augustine: Solidarity, Conflict, and the Practices of Charity'' (2024).<ref>{{Cite web|title=Teubner wins Manfred Lautenschlaeger Award for Theological Promise|url=https://www.acu.edu.au/about-acu/news/2018/december/irci-teubner-wins-manfred-lautenschlaeger-award-for-theological-promise|website=www.acu.edu.au|access-date=2026-03-03|language=en}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |last=Sherrard |first=Joey |date=2025-11-13 |title=Charity After Augustine {{!}} Jonathan D. Teubner |url=https://www.pastortheologians.com/book-reviews-archive/2025/11/13/charity-after-augustine |access-date=2026-03-03 |website=The Center for Pastor Theologians |language=en-US}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|title=Jonathan Teubner|url=http://iasculture.org/events/jonathan-teubner|website=Institute for Advanced Studies in Culture|access-date=2026-03-03|language=en}}</ref>
